summary: Iteration 2 full-stack testing. Backend: 9/9 pytest passing (auth, customers CRUD, parts CRUD with low_stock filter, repairs partial update -> consegnata+paid creates single cash entry (idempotent), sales creation decrements stock & creates cash, cash CRUD, dashboard with 14-day daily_series). Frontend: login, dashboard KPIs (4 cards + Recharts 14gg), auth guard on protected routes, logout, mobile Sheet menu, customer/part creation, low-stock filter, repair creation, cash movement, reports page all work. Only test-side issue: Select option labels are capitalized (e.g. 'Consegnata') so role-based option matching by lowercase name failed — not an app bug.

issues: Radix Dialog console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for {DialogContent}' on every modal (Customers, Parts, Repairs, Cash, Sales) — add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby for a11y.
Occasional recharts warning: 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' on initial render — set explicit min-height on ResponsiveContainer parent.

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to Dialog components to silence Radix a11y warning.
Optional: ensure ResponsiveContainer parents have min-height to avoid initial recharts sizing warning.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS: allow_origins is set with both FRONTEND_URL and '*' along with allow_credentials=True. Browsers reject credentials with wildcard origin; explicit origin still works but the '*' entry is misleading — remove '*' when credentials are enabled.
Cookie samesite='none' with secure=True is correct for cross-site, but ensure preview domain uses HTTPS (it does).
server.py: single-file 680 lines — acceptable for this MVP but consider splitting into routers (auth, customers, parts, repairs, sales, cash, reports) if it grows.
Sales endpoint decrements stock but does not guard against negative quantities or missing part_id resolution — could result in negative stock.
Delete endpoints (customer/part/sale/repair) return 200 even when nothing matched (delete_one silently no-ops). Consider returning 404 for missing ids.
@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in favor of lifespan handlers in modern FastAPI (still works).
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed customers/parts/repairs/sales/cash and delete them on completion. A few artefacts may persist if tests were interrupted (RIP-00005 TEST problema UI, TEST_Cliente UI, TEST_Parte UI) — safe to purge from DB if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 2 verified the partial-update fix on PUT /api/repairs (RepairUpdate model) end-to-end: sending only {status, paid} preserves other fields and triggers a single cash entry. Login response contains 'token' field consumed by frontend AuthContext. Only frontend script hiccup was matching Select options by lowercase role name — use exact capitalized labels ('Consegnata', 'Uscita', 'Smartphone') or click by role option with case-insensitive regex.
